# R: Into the tidyverse

## Class exercise
```{r}
load("data_three.RData")
dataset <- data1
dataset_other <- data2
x_mean <- mean(dataset$x)
y_mean <- mean(dataset$y)
x_stdev <- sd(dataset$x)

res <- lm(y ~ x, dataset)

```

```{r}
plot(dataset$x, dataset$y)
```

## R wrangling
With `tidyverse` and `ggplot` + `dplyr`.
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```

```r
# Group by fertilizer and summarize the height of mean
plants_long %>%
    group_by(fertilizer) %>%
    summarize(mean_h = mean(height))
```

Overlaps so use jitter.
```r
ggplot(long_drugs) +
    # geom_point(aes(x=Dose, y=Effect, color=Dose), cex=3)
    geom_jitter(aes(x=Dose, y=Effect, color=Dose), cex=3)
```

Use boxplot
```r
ggplot(long_drugs) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(x=Dose, y=Effect, color=Dose)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(x=Dose, y=Effect, color=Dose), cex=3)
```

Also beeswarm.

With multiple variables:
```r
# Stacked bar
# Add position = "dodge" to spread out
ggplot(Pet_long) +
    geom_col(aes(x=Pet, y=Number, fill=County))
```

Facetting.
```r
ggplot(Pet_long) +
    geom_col(aes(x=Pet, y=Number, fill=County)) +
    facet_wrap(~ County)
```
